name: osha filing preparation

product.purpose: Prepare customer-reviewed Form 300A worksheets from injury-log CSVs for eligible establishments, with the executive certifying and submitting through their own OSHA ITA account.
customer_output_vocabulary: no match found in [sources] as of [date]
product.government_submission: Customer reviews all figures, signs and dates the certification, and submits through their own OSHA ITA account. Glacier never certifies or submits.
product.mailing: Render-only postcard proofs and distinct landing pages. No real postcard is sent by this venture build.
product.billing: $49–199 per establishment per year; customer checkout remains disabled until an owner configures Stripe test mode.

block_functions: mail.postcard / mail.landing_pages (render-only; test mode required for any test send)
rules.check (OSHA 300A structural fields) + deterministic totals and hours checks
filer.prepare through a local-mock-only wrapper; no call to filer.submit

schedules.purpose: Refresh OSHA's public ITA submission file and prepare owner-reviewed January postcard proofs.
Remind the customer that ITA submission opens Jan 2 and is due Mar 2, and the signed Form 300A must be posted Feb 1–Apr 30.

your_steps.title: Owner: finish the source check and review launch materials
your_steps.detail: Download the current ITA Summary Data CSV from OSHA's official data page in a normal browser and run the local --source-csv screen to record its row count and establishment-ID canary; this client's feed request currently returns HTTP 403. Review the first postcard, recipient source, landing page, marketplace listing, and first five prepared worksheets. The Jobber test app is already connected; submit or publish its listing yourself only if you choose. Glacier does not send mail or publish listings.

your_steps.title: Customer: review, sign, post, and submit your Form 300A
your_steps.detail: Compare every field with your OSHA 300 Log and hours/headcount records. Your executive signs and dates the completed form, posts it February 1–April 30, and submits the required data in your OSHA ITA account by March 2 (submission opens January 2). Glacier only prepares a review worksheet.

launch_gates: Owner downloads the current OSHA ITA Summary Data CSV if the public feed remains blocked, then records the local screen's actual row count and establishment-ID canary.
The OSHA 300A arithmetic checks pass; missing data remains uncertain.
First postcard design and recipient are reviewed; no live outreach is enabled.
Owner reviews the first five prepared filing packets.
Owner reviews and submits the Jobber marketplace listing.
The customer, not Glacier, certifies and submits all government filings.
